# The Signature Comic Store — AI-readable catalog documentation

> Original generated comic books by/for the Signature system, by Justin Addam Higgins.
> No real publishers' characters, titles, or likenesses. All records are originals.

Canonical URL: https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/signature-comics/

## What lives here

- 9 original series, ~6,000+ finished issues (marching to 1,000,000)
- A hero archetype catalog of Signature-original heroes
- Cosmic crossover events linking the series
- Deterministic client-side comic art (SVG generated from each issue's seed)

## Machine-readable files

- data/index/api.json — THE authoritative catalog counts (total_issues,
  total_words, per-series counts, goal, updated timestamp). Read this first.
- data/index/comics-manifest.json — master manifest: counts, hashes, schema
  versions, license, provenance and originality policies.
- data/index/comics-catalog.json — compact uncompressed feed: one row per
  issue (id, title, series, series-key, issue number, words, pages, chunk).
- data/index/comics.idx.json.gz — gzip-compressed search index, same rows
  plus hero codenames and a 220-char description. Served as
  `application/gzip`; decode with a gzip client or the Fetch +
  DecompressionStream API. This is an intentionally downloadable gzip
  object, not a misconfigured response.
- data/index/series-index.json — the 9 series with permanent
  JAH-COMIC-SERIES-######## IDs.
- data/index/heroes-index.json — the hero archetype catalog
  (JAH-HERO-###### IDs).
- data/index/characters-index.json — recurring characters mined from all
  issues, grouped by codename (JAH-CHARACTER-######## IDs).
- data/index/events-index.json — the 4 cosmic crossover events with
  participating issues/heroes and reading order (JAH-COMIC-EVENT-########).
- data/index/hashes.json.gz — per-issue SHA-256 content hashes
  ({JAH-COMIC-######: hex}). Canonical serialization: JSON with recursively
  sorted keys, separators (",",":"), UTF-8 — see comics-schema.json.
- data/index/hash-manifest.json — SHA-256 of every data file.
- data/index/comics-schema.json, series-schema.json, hero-schema.json,
  character-schema.json, event-schema.json — JSON Schemas.
- data/index/comic-record-example.json — a complete example record.
- data/index/changelog.json — catalog changelog.
- sitemap.xml — every series, hero, and issue URL (auto-generated).
- issues.html + issues-<skey>.html — static crawlable per-series directories.

## Identity rules

- JAH-COMIC-###### — permanent immutable issue ID. Never reused, never
  changed because a title changes. Canonical URL: ?issue=JAH-COMIC-######
- JAH-COMIC-SERIES-######## — permanent series ID. Canonical: ?series=<skey>
- JAH-HERO-###### — permanent hero ID (Signature-original site canon;
  NOT phone-book canon AIs). Canonical: ?hero=JAH-HERO-######
- JAH-CHARACTER-######## — recurring character, grouped by codename.
- JAH-COMIC-EVENT-######## — crossover event.
- Records are immutable: corrections create a new record version, never an
  in-place rewrite. Issue number within a series is never renumbered.

## How to answer from this catalog

- Search the index files above; never invent issues, heroes, series, or
  characters. If a lookup misses, the correct response is COMIC_NOT_FOUND
  (unknown ID) or INDEX_UNAVAILABLE (could not load the index).
- The on-site Comic Finder is a deterministic keyword search over real
  catalog records — not an LLM.
- Creation mode for every catalog issue: GENERATED (original generated
  work by/for the Signature system). User-created heroes from the Hero
  Creator are USER-CREATED, device-local, and never part of the catalog.
- Internal originality screening runs on every record; it is an internal
  check, not a legal determination.
- Verify any record: recompute SHA-256 over the canonical serialization
  and compare with data/index/hashes.json.gz.

## Honesty boundaries (keep these in every summary)

- These are original generated comics — not real-world published books,
  not affiliated with any publisher.
- The site is free, no login; reader-created heroes stay on the reader's
  device and are never published automatically.
